DPZ.headline: DPZ: +1.83% observed, -0.36% historical factor fit, +2.19% unexplained

relationships.title: 10-year Treasury yield × DPZ
relationships.summary: 10-year Treasury yield changed +15.00 bp; historical fit associates this with -1.13% in DPZ over 20 shared sessions.

evidence.label: 10-year Treasury yield change over 20 common sessions
evidence.formula: Sum of daily factor changes on 20 common factor/equity sessions

evidence.label: Historical sensitivity
evidence.unit: % stock return per 1 bp yield change
evidence.formula: OLS with intercept, holding other included factors fixed

evidence.label: Associated contribution
evidence.formula: Historical coefficient × summed factor change; additive, not compounded

relationships.counterargument: Co-movement is not causation. Other factors, earnings and coefficient instability may reverse this interpretation.

relationships.title: VIX × DPZ
relationships.summary: VIX changed +4.18 index points; historical fit associates this with -0.76% in DPZ over 20 shared sessions.

evidence.label: VIX change over 20 common sessions
evidence.formula: Sum of daily factor changes on 20 common factor/equity sessions

evidence.label: Historical sensitivity
evidence.unit: % stock return per 1 VIX point change
evidence.formula: OLS with intercept, holding other included factors fixed

evidence.label: Associated contribution
evidence.formula: Historical coefficient × summed factor change; additive, not compounded

relationships.counterargument: Co-movement is not causation. Other factors, earnings and coefficient instability may reverse this interpretation.

relationships.title: What the factor fit leaves unexplained
relationships.summary: +2.19% of the 2026-10-16 move remains outside this historical fit; check company disclosures.

evidence.label: Fitted return including intercept
evidence.formula: intercept + sum(coefficient × same-session factor change)

evidence.label: Unexplained return
evidence.formula: observed − fitted

relationships.counterargument: The residual also includes model error and omitted risks; it does not establish company news or mispricing.

relationships.title: If the 10-year yield rose 25 bp

evidence.formula: User-independent standardized what-if; not a forecast

relationships.title: VIX: measured shock exposure

validation.target: Next equity-session adjusted-close return (%) with one additional session factor delay
validation.benchmark: Trailing training-window mean return; same dates as fitted model

holdout.method: Chronological expanding walk-forward; last up to 60 targets; refit only on earlier targets

validation.summary: 502 companies audited; 115 beat baseline MSE in this sample. This is not demonstrated predictive edge: no point-in-time macro vintages, membership history, execution costs or independent replication.

methods.association: OLS with intercept on up to 252 same-session adjusted-close stock returns (%) and factor changes; minimum 120 sessions. Same-day fit is descriptive.
methods.attribution: Fitted return includes intercept. Unexplained = observed minus fitted; residual is not proved company-specific news.
methods.scenario: Coefficient × hypothetical factor shock, holding other factors fixed; excludes intercept. No probability or return forecast.
methods.selection: Research leads choose greatest absolute 20-session historical factor contribution per macro factor, without optimizing a forecast or implying a trade.
methods.validation: For target t, factors observed at equity session t−2. Training targets strictly precede holdout target. Missing dates never forward-filled. Revised series limit point-in-time validity.
